results.sql: SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM=1
SELECT INSTANCE_NAME, HOST_NAME, TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM V$INSTANCE
SELECT MODE$ FROM V$INSTANCE
SELECT (SYSDATE-START_TIME)*86400 FROM v$instance
SELECT ARCH_MODE FROM V$DATABASE
SELECT count(*) FROM v$sessions WHERE STATE='ACTIVE'
SELECT count(*) FROM v$sessions
SELECT VALUE FROM v$parameter WHERE name='MAX_SESSIONS'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRX_ID) FROM V$LOCK WHERE BLOCKED = 1

SELECT NAME, ROUND(TOTAL_SIZE * PAGE / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) as TOTAL_MB, ROUND(USED_SIZE * PAGE / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) as USED_MB, CASE WHEN TOTAL_SIZE > 0 THEN ROUND(USED_SIZE * 100.0 / TOTAL_SIZE, 2) ELSE 0 END as USED_PCT FROM ( SELECT t.NAME, t.TOTAL_SIZE, t.USED_SIZE, (SELECT CAST(VALUE AS INT) FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME = 'GLOBAL_PAGE_SIZE') as PAGE FROM V$TABLESPACE t )

SELECT NAME, ROUND(TOTAL_SIZE * PAGE / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) as TOTAL_MB FROM ( SELECT t.NAME, t.TOTAL_SIZE, (SELECT CAST(VALUE AS INT) FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME = 'GLOBAL_PAGE_SIZE') as PAGE FROM V$TABLESPACE t WHERE t.TYPE$ = 2 )
SELECT count(*), SUM(TOTAL_SIZE * PAGE) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 FROM V$TABLESPACE
SELECT VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='BUFFER'
SELECT STAT_VAL FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME='sql executed count'
SELECT STAT_VAL FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE NAME='transaction total count'
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(N_LOGIC_READS + N_PHY_READS) > 0 THEN ROUND((1 - SUM(N_PHY_READS) * 1.0 / SUM(N_LOGIC_READS + N_PHY_READS)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as CACHE_HIT_RATIO FROM V$BUFFERPOOL

SELECT t.SESS_ID, s.USER_NAME, t.ID as TRANSACTION_ID, SUBSTR(s.SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT, l.LMODE, l.BLOCKED FROM V$LOCK l LEFT JOIN V$TRX t ON l.TRX_ID = t.ID LEFT JOIN V$SESSIONS s ON t.SESS_ID = s.SESS_ID WHERE l.BLOCKED = 1
SELECT WAIT_CLASS, COUNT(*) as CNT FROM V$WAIT_HISTORY WHERE WAIT_CLASS != 'Idle' GROUP BY WAIT_CLASS ORDER BY CNT DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT SESS_ID, USER_NAME, STATE, CLNT_IP, CLNT_HOST, APPNAME, SUBSTR(SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT, TRX_ID FROM V$SESSIONS WHERE USER_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY STATE, SESS_ID LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SQL_ID, SUBSTR(TOP_SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT, COUNT(*) as EXECUTE_COUNT, AVG(TIME_USED) as AVG_TIME FROM V$SQL_HISTORY GROUP BY SQL_ID, TOP_SQL_TEXT ORDER BY EXECUTE_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SQL_ID, SUBSTR(TOP_SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT, COUNT(*) as EXECUTE_COUNT FROM V$SQL_HISTORY GROUP BY SQL_ID, TOP_SQL_TEXT ORDER BY EXECUTE_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
SELECT ID, NAME, PAGE_SIZE, N_TOTAL_PAGES, FREE, N_DIRTY, N_PHY_READS FROM V$BUFFERPOOL
SELECT count(*) FROM V$TRX
SELECT count(*) FROM V$SESSIONS WHERE STATE='INACTIVE' AND TRX_ID != 0
SELECT ARCH_TYPE, ARCH_DEST, ARCH_STATUS, ARCH_SRC FROM V$ARCH_STATUS
SELECT count(*) FROM V$ARCH_FILE
SELECT ROLE$ FROM V$DATABASE
SELECT PATH, STATUS, CREATE_TIME, CLOSE_TIME, ARCH_SEQ, DB_MAGIC FROM V$ARCH_FILE WHERE 1=0
SELECT INSTANCE_NAME, INSTANCE_NUMBER, HOST_NAME, NULL as PORT_NUM, STATUS$, NULL as IS_PRIMARY, NULL as UPTIME FROM V$INSTANCE
SELECT DSC_NODES FROM V$DATABASE
SELECT ARCH_SEQ, PATH, STATUS, CREATE_TIME, CLOSE_TIME, DB_MAGIC FROM V$ARCH_FILE WHERE 1=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$LOCK WHERE BLOCKED = 1
SELECT TOTAL_SPACE FROM V$RLOG
SELECT USER_NAME, COUNT(*) as CNT FROM V$SESSIONS WHERE STATE = 'FAILED' GROUP BY USER_NAME

SELECT t.ID as TRX_ID, t.SESS_ID, t.STATUS, (SYSDATE - s.CREATE_TIME) * 86400 as DURATION_SEC, SUBSTR(s.SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT FROM V$TRX t LEFT JOIN V$SESSIONS s ON t.SESS_ID = s.SESS_ID WHERE t.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (SYSDATE - s.CREATE_TIME) * 86400 > 60 ORDER BY DURATION_SEC DESC
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SESS_ID, TRX_ID, SQL_TEXT, HAPPEN_TIME FROM V$DEADLOCK_HISTORY ORDER BY HAPPEN_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$RLOG
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$RLOG WHERE ALMOST_FULL_STATUS <> 'SAFE'
SELECT VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='RLOG_BUF_SIZE'
SELECT VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME='RLOG_POOL_SIZE'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, NUM_ROWS, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(USED_SIZE * PAGE) / 1024 / 1024, 2) FROM V$TABLESPACE WHERE NAME = t.TABLESPACE_NAME) as SIZE_MB FROM DBA_TABLES t WHERE OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSDBA', 'SYSAUDITOR', 'SYSSSO') ORDER BY NUM_ROWS DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_TABLES WHERE OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSDBA', 'SYSAUDITOR','SYSSSO')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_INDEXES WHERE OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSDBA', 'SYSAUDITOR','SYSSSO')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_VIEWS WHERE OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSDBA', 'SYSAUDITOR','SYSSSO')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_PROCEDURES WHERE OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSDBA', 'SYSAUDITOR','SYSSSO')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_TRIGGERS WHERE OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSDBA', 'SYSAUDITOR','SYSSSO')
SELECT STATE, COUNT(*) FROM V$SESSIONS GROUP BY STATE
